data.title: Phone numbers still leak in the log
story: 🔥 PRODUCTION INCIDENT: The cashier log must not show a buyer's full phone number. The requested form: first 4 digits, ****, then the last 2 digits, for example 0812****89.
The function exists, but the result looks odd. Please fix it!

explanation: number[2:] takes almost the whole number from index 2, so the phone number still leaks. number[-2:] takes only the last 2 digits, whatever the length.
hints: Print number[2:] in the console. What does it contain?
Negative indexes count from the end: number[-2:] means the last 2 characters.
